page: UpCloud PREMIUM-2xCPU-2GB is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It features two shared vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2.0 GB of system memory, providing 1.0 GB of RAM per core, and a bundled 50 GB local SSD. The processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX_VNNI, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core performance alongside moderate multi-core and memory capabilities. The single-core stress-ng CPU test and single-threaded gzip compression place this server in the top 10% tier. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth fall into the average range, with uncached large-block memory read speeds at 63.77 GB/sec. The server exhibits performance tradeoffs in multi-threaded decompression and database operations, which rank in the bottom 25%, while Passmark memory scores are in the bottom 10%.

Given its shared CPU allocation and 2.0 GB memory capacity, this server offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring strong single-threaded CPU performance but low memory overhead. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic static content delivery, and simple background tasks. It is less suitable for memory-intensive databases or highly parallelized multi-threaded processing due to its memory bandwidth and multi-core scaling limitations.
